title: Teddy and Peddy Save Passengers
custom_script:
# Scene: City street
Teddy: {run} Peddy, let us ride our *motorcycle* across the town! {jump} [excited, point, shout, horn]
Peddy: {walk-to} {laugh} Hold on tight as we speed along! [happy, wave, excited]
# Time skip: Moments later...
# Scene: Railway Station (rail_track, train, big trees)
Teddy: {look-around} {gasp} Look, the *rail_track* is broken right here! [surprised, point, shout, gasp]
Peddy: {shock} Oh no, a *train* is coming this way fast! {scared} [surprised, facepalm, shout, horn]
# Time skip: Right before the train hits...
# Scene: Railway Station (rail_track, train)
Teddy: {run} Quick, we must *weld* the track before it arrives! {idea} [excited, point, shout, footsteps]
Peddy: {light-fire} {weld:rail_track} Fixed it just in time! {yay} [happy, point, excited, magic]
Teddy: {clap} Look, the *train* crossed safely over our fixed *rail_track*! {laugh} [happy, wave, applause]
Peddy: {high-five} {yay} The *passengers* are safe and cheering for us! [happy, idle, excited, ding]
